summary: AmperCap Acquisition Co filed an 8-K announcing the separate trading of its ordinary shares and rights, effective June 29, 2026. No merger, acquisition, or business combination is being announced. The filing is a routine post-IPO administrative step allowing unit holders to split units into ordinary shares (APMC) and rights (APMCR). No financial terms, premiums, or deal considerations are involved. This is not a special situation event; it is an ordinary corporate action related to the trading structure of the SPAC's securities. There is no transaction to analyze or risk-arb angle.
